findings.title: a violation with missing/null/unrecognized impact was silently passed (fail-OPEN — the one crack)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: `if(!failOn.has(impact)) continue` treated an unrecognized impact as below-threshold → a real violation with no/misspelled impact reports PASS, in a gate that advertises fail-closed
findings.evidence: reviewer RUN: violation with no impact field → exit 0; impact:null → exit 0 (contrast impact SERIOUS → exit 1)
findings.resolution: die (exit 2) when a violation's impact is absent/not in IMPACTS; 2 tests added. Low real-pipeline risk (axe always sets impact) but closes the only fail-open path

findings.title: failOn:[] turned the gate into a silent no-op (vacuous green)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: an explicit empty failOn passed everything incl critical, exit 0, no warning
findings.evidence: reviewer RUN: failOn:[] + critical → OK exit 0
findings.resolution: die when failOn resolves empty; test added

findings.title: run-axe wcagTags default omitted wcag21a (harmless drift vs example/ADR)
findings.question: ownership
findings.whatBreaks: default tag list drifted from the example config + ADR (example supplies tags explicitly, so harmless)
findings.resolution: added wcag21a to the default to match

verdict: 3 findings (1 med fail-open, 2 low), all fixed with tests; design sound + honestly documented
